summary: Configured node1 to run /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as the enabled systemd service inventory-worker under the dedicated non-login inventorysvc account. The service recovered successfully after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Created the inventorysvc system account with /sbin/nologin.
Configured systemd to execute the worker as inventorysvc with automatic failure restart.
Verified the live process identity and executable.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the enabled service and inventorysvc-owned worker process recovered after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Run os-comparison-worker as the managed inventory-worker service under inventorysvc
evidence.summary: Shows the dedicated non-login account, enabled and active unit, configured user/group and executable, and live inventorysvc-owned worker process before and after reboot.
Captures the healthy baseline boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, new boot ID, explicit identity comparison, and recovered enabled/active service with a new live worker process.
